title: Almirol: eGov deals went to PLDT firms serving gov’t before me

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — There was no conflict of interest in the P1.55 billion in e-government contracts now under investigation, as they went to companies of the PLDT group, the country’s largest telecommunications conglomerate, which has served government agencies and private businesses for decades. “I firmly maintain that there was no conflict of interest,” Undersecretary David Almirol Jr. of the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) said in a statement posted on his official Facebook page on Thursday, a day after the Office of the Ombudsman placed him under a six-month preventive suspension. “No DICT contract was awarded to Multisys,” Almirol […]...
